title: Major Investment in City Services
summary:
*   City officials approved the issuance of $6.75 million in bonds.
*   These funds are earmarked for significant expansion and improvement of Austin's combined electric, water, and sewer systems.
*   This bond package is part of a larger $17.5 million infrastructure project previously authorized by voters.
*   Repayment for the bonds will come directly from the revenues generated by the city's utility systems.

OPERATING AND MAINTAINING SAID COMBINED SYSTEM; ENACTING PROVISIONS INCIDENT AND RELATING
